stages.title: EIGHT DELIBERATION DESIGN TESTS

pills.text: EIGHT DELIBERATION DESIGN TESTS
1 AUTHORITY
IS THE FORUM DECIDING, OR ADVISING ON A DECISION
2 TIMING
IS IT CONSULTED BEFORE THE OPTIONS ARE FORECLOSED
3 INFORMATION
BUDGET, OPTIONS AND TRADE-OFFS IN USABLE FORM AND LANGUAGE
4 INCLUSION

sequence: 1 AUTHORITY → is the forum deciding, or advising on a decision already taken
2 TIMING → is it consulted before the options are foreclosed
3 INFORMATION → budget, options and trade-offs in usable form and language
4 INCLUSION → who is absent: women, landless, migrants, disabled persons, the poorest
5 FACILITATION → independent facilitator, or the implementing agency running its own hearing
